title: Share a path prefix
summary: Laravel: Share a path prefix. Add a pets route inside the group.
introduction: A route group can share a prefix. Open GET /api/books. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Share a path prefix with Laravel
Add a pets route inside the group

blocks.text: Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.

blocks.title: Share a path prefix
blocks.code:
<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
Route::prefix("api")->group(function () {
 Route::get("books", fn () => response()->json(["Moon Trip"]));
});

blocks.text: The group prefix api and inner books path combine to /api/books.
Add a pets route inside the group.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: In this web.php example the api prefix is added explicitly.
